relations: Glowing embers radiate continuous heat, sustaining the combustion of adjacent wood pieces.
The bright flame flickers and shifts as volatile gases from the burning wood mix with oxygen.
As the wood structure degrades, the embers slowly collapse, causing the flame's intensity to fluctuate.
Smoke rises from the cooler edges of the fire, drifting upward into the dark background.
